value.rationale: Symmetric curve trace is a natural operation on weighted analytic quotient modules. The theorem distinguishes two geometrically exceptional twists, quantifies the noncompact interior operator by its precise essential level, and gives a sharp Schatten cutoff across Dirichlet/Hardy/Bergman kernel exponents. The high-rank spectral constant changes at arithmetic resonances (e.g. Hardy \(\theta=\pi/2\) versus irrational angles), which a generic kernel-norm estimate cannot capture. This is structural spectral information for a natural operator rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
